candidate.finalDelta: Only report, checklist, task status and this summary change after measurement; production/tests/tools remain frozen.

interpretation: All performance is local Apple M5 Darwin arm64 Node24.19.0; no cloud D6 pass or frozen threshold.
Full baseline and window observations are one round of 2049 inputs per case; mixed workload/identities are not an A/B regression verdict.

Rotated comparisons use three rounds: 32 baseline single inputs or 8 candidate 100-tick windows. All fixed windows actually total 800 ticks and 8 environment blocks. Small n is diagnostic, not a stable tail estimate.

Layer timers are inclusive/overlapping wall time. Total CPU covers measurement loop, diagnostic projections and final save/export/flush across process threads, excluding setup and verification; synchronous CPU is a separate subset.
GC timestamps/durations are observational; memory is process endpoints, not peak/per-member net/browser memory. Node API readiness is not visible browser prompt/click latency.
Bytes are UTF-8 JSON.stringify compact payloads; pretty transport files are larger. Segment bytes include event/checkpoint fields, not all recording acceleration overhead.
Cache-off diagnostic clears before stat queries and includes clearing cost; only equal mechanical workloads are compared. It does not measure the exact cache contribution to the full long-run trend.
Initial incomplete/invalid windows and cache-import failures are archived separately and never included as passing measurements.
